senses.def: a river in the central Netherlands flowing north to the IJsselmeer
A river in Gelderland province and Overijssel province, Netherlands, which flows from the Rhine and discharges into the IJsselmeer.
a river in the central Netherlands flowing north to the IJsselmeer
